statement: A business operator must apply for business registration (사업자등록) with the district tax office for each place of business within 20 days from the start of business; a person starting a new business may apply before the start date, and the application may be filed with any district tax office (Value-Added Tax Act Article 8(1), (2)).
caveat: Registration is filed through Hometax in practice and, for a corporation, follows the court-registry incorporation registration; simplified-taxpayer and VAT-exempt businesses follow their own registration provisions. Verify the current procedure on Hometax before relying.
